title: Add crash recovery and stale task reconciliation
summary: Added crash recovery and stale task reconciliation module (src/crash-recovery.js) with 20 deterministic tests. The reconcile() function inspects heartbeat, claim lock, supervisor lock, .hermes/state.json, GitHub issue state, and existing reports to produce a machine-readable outcome (NO_ACTION, RECOVERED, RESUME_REQUIRED, MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, RUNTIME_ERROR). Stale artifacts are cleaned only when evidence is explicit; ambiguous states escalate to manual review. Recovery evidence is appended to .hermes/recovery/recovery-evidence.log. GitHub labels are corrected after live revalidation when a matching report exists. The operating manual (docs/HERMES_OPERATING_MANUAL_RC1.md) is updated with crash recovery documentation and operator remediation guidelines.

validation.jsonParseChecks: PASS (handover JSON, state JSON all valid)

outcomeCodes.PROCESS_ALIVE: Active runtime process running — no action
outcomeCodes.CLAIM_OWNER_ALIVE: Active claim lock owner process running — no action
outcomeCodes.SUPERVISOR_ALIVE: Active supervisor process running — no action
outcomeCodes.ALL_CLEAN: No stale artifacts present — no action
outcomeCodes.COMPLETED_ELSEWHERE: Issue completed on GitHub — stale artifacts cleaned
outcomeCodes.ISSUE_CLOSED_STALE_STATE: Issue closed but state showed IN_PROGRESS — recovered
outcomeCodes.REPORT_EXISTS_STALE_ARTIFACTS: Matching report exists — stale artifacts cleaned, labels corrected
outcomeCodes.STALE_LOCK_WITH_REPORT: Stale claim lock with matching report — cleaned
outcomeCodes.STALE_LOCK_CLEANED: Stale claim lock removed (no IN_PROGRESS state)
outcomeCodes.AMBIGUOUS_CRASH_NO_REPORT: Stale artifacts + IN_PROGRESS + no report — manual review required
outcomeCodes.IN_PROGRESS_WITHOUT_LOCK: IN_PROGRESS state without claim lock — manual review required
outcomeCodes.STALE_LOCK_IN_PROGRESS: Stale claim lock with IN_PROGRESS state — manual review required
outcomeCodes.IN_PROGRESS_ALONE: IN_PROGRESS state alone — manual review required
outcomeCodes.CROSS_HOST_LOCK: Claim lock from different host — manual review required
outcomeCodes.GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE: GitHub lookup failed — manual review required
outcomeCodes.UNRECOGNIZED_STATE: Unrecognized state combination — manual review required

crashRecoveryModule.labelCorrectionRule: When a matching report exists and GitHub still shows hermes:working, add pm:review + hermes:done and remove hermes:working

tests.allClean: Stale heartbeat + stale claim lock + matching report → RECOVERED
tests.staleHeartbeatStaleLock: Stale heartbeat + stale claim lock + matching report → RECOVERED
tests.ambiguousCrash: Stale artifacts + IN_PROGRESS + no report + open issue → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.staleLockWithReport: Stale claim lock with matching report → RECOVERED
tests.staleLockInProgress: Stale claim lock with IN_PROGRESS state → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.inProgressAlone: IN_PROGRESS state without lock or heartbeat → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.crossHostLock: Claim lock from different host → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.crossHostArtifacts: Stale artifacts from different host → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.labelCorrection: Recovery corrects stale hermes:working on GitHub
tests.supervisorAlive: Active supervisor lock with alive PID → NO_ACTION
tests.staleHeartbeatOnly: Stale heartbeat without claim lock → RECOVERED
tests.staleHeartbeatInProgress: Stale heartbeat with IN_PROGRESS state (no lock) → MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
tests.staleLockClean: Stale claim lock without IN_PROGRESS state → RECOVERED
tests.stoppedHeartbeat: STOPPED heartbeat with clean state → NO_ACTION
tests.hermesWorkingStale: Recovery corrects hermes:working when report exists

risks: Crash recovery reconciliation is not yet integrated into the worker startup lifecycle — must be invoked explicitly
Cross-host artifacts always escalate to manual review (conservative), even when the issue is completed on GitHub
Evidence log grows unbounded — should be rotated or archived periodically
